integrity: Proof and finite independent checks supplied; independent expert audit has not been carried out. Underlying homometric pair not claimed new.
scientific_limitations: Two-element blocks and cyclic characters only. Mathematical generality rests on direct local-intertwiner proof and cycle transfer, not on finite computational tests. The homometric eight-set example and general full-transformation centralizer criteria are previously known; historical novelty of the specialized rank and probability refinements remains subject to broader literature priority checks.
title: Cyclic-block transformation centralizers, rank transfer, and homometric fibers
